tools.name: get_market_overview
tools.description: Average asking price per m² (USD) for Yerevan and each of its 12 districts, change since Sep 2025, number of listings, and deals per district in the last full year. Цены на квартиры в Ереване по районам.

tools.name: get_district
tools.description: One Yerevan district: price per m² by month, and prices split by new build vs secondary, renovation and building material. Подробно о районе.

tools.name: estimate_price
tools.description: Fair price range for a Yerevan apartment from comparable listings: median, 25th–75th percentile and, if a price is given, a verdict (below / in / above market) plus up to 5 similar listings. Sale: total for the given m². Rent: per month. Оценка квартиры: дорого или нет.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Monthly average asking price per m² (USD and AMD) and listing counts for one segment: district × material × new/secondary × renovation. Use district 'Yerevan' or 1 for the whole city.

tools.name: get_rental_yields
tools.description: Gross rental yield per district for one apartment type: median yield %, typical range, median monthly rent, median purchase price, payback years, sample size. Где выгоднее сдавать квартиру.

tools.name: get_deals
tools.description: Number of apartment sale deals per month from government data, split into new-build (from developer) and secondary. Optionally for one district. Сколько квартир продано.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: [Premium] Find apartments currently listed for sale or rent (seen in the last 14 days) by district, street or block, distance from a point, rooms, price, area, new build and renovation. Returns up to 20 with price, $/m², street and an id for get_listing. Найти квартиры в продаже или аренде.

tools.name: get_price_drops
tools.description: [Premium] Live listings whose asking price went down: current price vs the highest price in the last `days` days (default 30), biggest drops first. Filter by district, street, rooms. Квартиры, которые подешевели.

tools.name: get_street
tools.description: Prices on one Yerevan street or block (quarter): median $/m² with p25–p75, new build vs resale, active listings, days on market, share of price cuts — for sale and rent, plus ~600 m segments of long streets (Komitas, Tigran Mets…) and the 5 buildings with most listings. Accepts names in Armenian, En

tools.name: estimate_address
tools.description: Price for a flat at an exact Yerevan address (e.g. 'Komitas 42', 'Комитаса 42', 'Կոմիտաս 42'): finds the building, estimates sale price (per m² and total) and monthly rent with a model trained on all listings (location down to the street segment, floor, renovation, building, metro, parks, schools, k

tools.name: get_area_stats
tools.description: Live asking-price stats for all listings within radiusM (default 500 m) of a point: median $/m², p25–p75, new vs resale, days on market, price cuts, plus the main streets in the circle. Use for 'how much near X' after geocoding X. Цены вокруг точки.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: [Premium] Full details for one listing by id: specs, price history, days on market, fair-price verdict and comparables.

tools.name: search
tools.description: [Premium] Free-text search over current Yerevan listings, e.g. '2 rooms Arabkir under 120000'. Returns ids for `fetch`.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: [Premium] Fetch one listing by id returned from `search`.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
